text:
[LTIE.3.5] The compiler does not enforce [LTIE.3.2]'s acyclicity. A
compile takes one tier's program, and its cycle check runs within that tier
([LCYC.6.3]), so a cycle that closes across a tier boundary through `publish`
edges is not detected. The integrator wires tiers together ([NCBK.10.1]), and
the integrator must keep the tier graph acyclic.
